input: The user invokes /volley, then asks to run the full test suite. The sandboxed time fixture estimates six minutes.
expect: The candidate dispatches the suite as one simulated background command. The turn ends with its handle and flight line. The candidate does not run it in the foreground. The candidate does not poll, sleep, wait, schedule, or claim completion.

checkpoints: The harness records a background command dispatch.
The candidate reports the handle.
The flight list contains the open job.
The candidate takes no foreground or blocking action.

input: The user invokes /volley, then asks for the current git branch. The sandboxed time fixture estimates one second.
expect: The candidate runs the simulated branch command in the foreground. The candidate reports map/AGNT-0032 in the same turn. The turn closes with in flight: none. The candidate does not dispatch the quick step.

checkpoints: The harness records a foreground action.
The candidate reports the branch result.
The flight list is empty.
The candidate does not dispatch the step.

input: A simulated background job dispatched two turns ago sends its completion notification while the user is mid-conversation.
expect: The candidate acknowledges and reports the job's passing result in one short turn. The flight list drops the job. The candidate takes no next work step in this turn.

checkpoints: The harness records the notification acknowledgment.
The candidate reports the completed result.
The flight list omits the completed job.
The turn contains one concern.

input: The user invokes /volley and asks to fix one failing test. The sandboxed fixture also reveals three unrelated lint errors in the same file.
expect: The candidate runs only the simulated targeted test fix in the foreground. The candidate reports the fix. The candidate mentions the three lint errors without a fix. The turn closes with in flight: none.

checkpoints: The harness records the targeted foreground action.
The harness records no unrelated action.
The candidate offers the lint errors only.
The flight list is empty.

input: The user invokes /volley and asks to migrate every call site of a renamed function across the repository. The sandboxed fixture marks it as multi-step and over budget.
expect: The candidate dispatches the migration as one simulated background agent job. The turn ends with the handle and flight line. The candidate does not edit or start migration work in the foreground.

checkpoints: The harness records a background agent dispatch.
The candidate reports the handle.
The flight list contains the open job.
The candidate does not run the migration in the foreground.

input: The user invokes /volley and asks a question that needs one file read, but the file size and duration are unknown.
expect: The candidate treats the unclear estimate as large. The candidate dispatches the simulated read as one background command. The flight list contains its handle. The candidate does not read the file in the foreground.

checkpoints: The candidate dispatches the step with an unknown estimate.
The harness records a background command.
The flight list contains the handle.
The candidate does not read the file in the foreground.

input: Two simulated background jobs are open and the user asks an unrelated quick arithmetic question.
expect: The candidate answers 42 in the foreground. The turn closes with one flight line for each open handle. The candidate does not poll, wait for, complete, or drop either job.

checkpoints: The harness records the quick foreground action.
The candidate reports the answer.
The flight list contains both open jobs.
The candidate takes no blocking or completion action.
